title: Endgame Group Intelligence + compounding Vault index
summary: YTIntel now moves materially closer to the Endgame brief beyond the one-video report. Group Video Analysis has been rebuilt around exact side-by-side thumbnails, titles, hooks, views, outliers, WPM, first-payoff timing and Most Replayed timing; shared-pattern claims require support from at least two source videos; the output always ends with a Creator-DNA video-to-make blueprint. The Vault now exposes an Endgame index of accumulated niches, packages, title keywords, hook types and motion/change classes, while Watchtower adds a competitive brief for the hottest outlier and fastest measured view velocity.
discord_changes: GROUP VIDEO ANALYSIS 2.0: exact thumbnails + titles + hooks + stats + payoff/replay timing are compared side by side, with repeated mechanics separated from one-off quirks.
PRESCRIPTIVE ENDGAME: every successful group pull now finishes with a Creator-DNA title/hook/thumbnail/beat-sheet blueprint even when the optional local model is unavailable.
COMPOUNDING VAULT: the Vault now indexes accumulated niches, package keywords, hook types and motion/change classes; Watchtower surfaces the hottest current outlier and fastest saved velocity.
changes: Rebuilt the Compare tab as Endgame Group Video Analysis for 2–10 source videos.
Added exact thumbnail cards beside each source title and channel so packaging can be inspected visually rather than reduced to metadata.
Added one cross-video numbers table containing views, channel-relative outlier, WPM, hook type, exact opening/hook line, first payoff, top replay, title overlap and hook overlap.
Added deterministic shared-title and shared-hook pattern mining where a pattern must appear in at least two source videos before it is called shared.
Added title-architecture comparison and per-video title/hook overlap percentages against the group-level repeated signals.
Added optional on-device thumbnail vision reads when local vision is already enabled; exact thumbnails remain visible even when semantic vision is unavailable.
Added a strongest-source difference card ranked by channel-relative outlier when available, while explicitly avoiding causal claims from performance alone.

Added an always-available Creator-DNA prescription with title directions, hook direction, thumbnail direction, beat sheet, transferable mechanics, do-not-copy constraints and post-publish measurements.
Kept the existing optional local-model group synthesis as a second-pass refinement instead of making prescriptive output depend on model availability.
Expanded saved comparison records with repeated title/hook signals, group stats, winner evidence, the creator blueprint and available thumbnail reads.
Added an Endgame Vault Index showing winner analyses, packages, comparisons and style records plus repeating niche, title-keyword, hook-type and motion/change patterns.
Added a Watchtower Brief summarising tracked competitors, hottest current channel-relative outlier, fastest measured view velocity and snapshot history.

Carried forward the v0.37.1 Analyse cleanup: Creator DNA outside Analyse, compact progress, folded Activity, rebuilt summary/takeaways/rehooks/payoffs/replay, packaging vault receipt, hidden raw Vault entry and clean Markdown export.
Added deployed-browser regression coverage for the v0.37.2 Compare, Vault and Watchtower Endgame surfaces while retaining the full one-video Analyse regression proof.
known_limitations: True automatic thumbnail composition comparison is strongest when the optional on-device vision model is available. Without it, YTIntel shows the exact thumbnails and performs title/hook/package evidence comparisons without inventing visual attributes.
YouTube does not expose a reliable Most Replayed curve for every video. Missing replay evidence remains missing rather than being fabricated.
Public storyboard sprites are sampled seek-bar evidence rather than every encoded frame. Exact frame-by-frame visual semantics remain an active Endgame workstream.

True waveform-level music/SFX/silence classification still requires an accessible audio stream plus supported local audio intelligence. Caption-coded cues and attributed tracks remain the zero-credit fallback.
Group pattern mining currently treats repeated source-supported terms and measured timing as evidence of recurrence, not proof that those patterns caused performance.
Watchtower velocity depends on repeated snapshots; a brand-new competitor has no historical velocity until it has been observed more than once.
why_it_matters: The Endgame brief is not just a long single-video analysis. The durable product is a compounding creator intelligence system: compare winners together, learn only from patterns that repeat, convert them into a video the user should make, bank those lessons, and watch competitors for the next move. v0.37.2 makes those system-level loops materially more useful while keeping evidence limits explicit.
